generalCriterionList.description: Tenders from Joint ventures are not acceptable.
Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of e-Procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidder s end.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Bidder shall pay Contract Management Module processing fees of 0.025% of the contact value (Min Rs.500/- & Max Rs.7500/-) soon after contract has been issued to bidder.
Total value of civil engineering works executed and payments received in the last five years (year-wise)
List of existing commitments and ongoing work
List of works for which tenders already submitted
Conditional tenders will not be accepted
The tenderer shall bear all costs associated with the preparation and submission of his tender and the employer will in no case be responsible and liable for these costs
The employer reserves the rights to reject one or all Tender without assigning any reasons
The employer is not responsible for any delay in accessing E-Procurement 2.0 Portal
Royalty on construction materials and other taxes will be deducted as per prevailing Govt orders

As per Government order LD/300/LET/2006 Bangalore dated 1.01.2007 nad Government letter no PW/134/BMS/2007 dated 27.07.2007, a sum amounting to 1% of the bill amount will be deducted towards constructions labour welfare fund
All the formats prescribed in the bid document shall be filled by the tenderer in complete manner otherwise it will be rejected
All scanned documents to be uploaded shall be in original and the Executive Engineer reserves the right to verify the documents before approval
Materials required for the work shall be procured by the tenderer themselves and should got tested by the quality control authority before use on the work.
Contractor should carryout additional test required to test the suitability of materials.

All safety precautions, warning signs, night illumination, reflectors, deployment of security guards has to be ensured so that no untoward incident happens on account of negligence or any project activity. Contractor should indemnify the client to that extent.
All precautions should be taken by the contractor so that there are no damages to such public/ private properties. If any damage is caused, it has to be rectified at his own risk and cost.
Contractor should follow strictly the prevailing rules of labour act.

At the time of agreement, the successfull bidder/contractor should submit proposed methodology and programme of construction backed with equipment and material planning, & deployment duly supported with broad calculation and quality management , plan, proposed to be adopted justifying their capability of execution , completion of the work and cast flow forecasts as per technical specifications and within the stipulated period of completion.

Security deposit for an amount equivalent to 5% of the contract price shall be deducted in every running bill. However, in case of first and final bill the entire security deposit will be deducted from the final bill.
The contractor s assessed available tender capacity will be calculated as prescribed in tender document Attached.
The intending contractors are requested to note that they should abide by the detailed instructions and conditions contained in the Standard Tender documents attached.
Contractors should be registered with KPWD Class III and above Registration
Contractor shall bound to comply the prevailing rules and regulations with regard to the EPF Contribution rules and any modifications thereof before and after execution of agreement
The FSD deducted in RA bills will be refunded only after successful completion of Defect Liability Period
Contractors has to submit their labour EPF details with every Running Bill
The increase in GST shall not be paid in the extended period of contract for which the Contractor alone is responsible for delay as determined by the authority while granting the extension of time.
The rates are EXCLUSIVE of 18 percent GST in the Estimate and The Amount put to tender is EXCLUSIVE of 18 percent GST
To qualify for award of this contract, each tenderer should give all details and documents as per K.W-2
Work should be carried out as per K/W-2 STD attached with tender .
GST 18% shall be paid to the tendered amount separately.
The Tendered should maintain the ROAD UPTO AUGUST 30 2027 (30-08-2027)
The contractor belonging to CATEGORY IIA should upload Caste Certificate issued by Competent Authority.
If the contractor is a firm, then all the partners or members of the firm shall belong to the CATEGORY IIA as the case may be
The contractor belonging to CATEGORY IIA shall be domicile of the State of Karnataka for more than 10 years-Should upload Certificate issued by Competent Authority.
The contractor should maintain the work during the defective liability period i.e. for 1 year after the completion of work at his own cost

itemList.description: Clearing  &  grubbing  road  land  including  vegetation,  bushes, shrubs, saplings by using weed cutter / minor equipment. ---- All the items in the tender include all lead, lifts, loading unloading, transportation, labour, hire charges of machinery curing forconcrete works, cost and conveyance of all material and all other such incidental charges necessary for successful completionof works as per the detailed technical specification and direction of Engineer in charge of this work

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -16- PANCHAYATH RAJ ENGINEERING DEPARTMENT ITEMS
itemList.description: Maintenance of Drains - The maintenance of drains include erosion, repair, clearing, cleaning,  reshaping,  regrading,  deepening  of  side  drains as well as catch water drains as per technical specification Clause 1908. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 1908 ---- All the items in the tender include all lead, lifts, loading unloading, transportation, labour, hire charges of machinery curing forconcrete works, cost and conveyance of all material and all other such incidental charges necessary for successful completionof works as per the detailed technical specification and direction of Engineer in charge of this work

Maintenance of Earth Shoulder (stripping excess soil) - Stripping excess soil from the shoulder surface to achieve the approved level and compacting with plate compactor. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 3003 ---- All the items in the tender include all lead, lifts, loading unloading, transportation, labour, hire charges of machinery curing forconcrete works, cost and conveyance of all material and all other such incidental charges necessary for successful completionof works as per the detailed technical specification and direction of Engineer in charge of this work

Patching of Potholes - Patching of Shallow Potholes using SDBC Gr II 25 mm thick - Patching  of  shallow  potholes  on  asphalt  surfaces  by  using Semi Dense Bituminous Concrete 25mm thickness. The Cost is inclusive of removing the failed materials & cleaning on the road surface, preparation of potholes to the required standards sizes before patching them and application of tack coat at 0.20 kg/ m2 over the asphalt surface including lead, loading unloading, rolling and finishing etc., complete as per specification. ---- All the items in the tender include all lead, lifts, loading unloading, transportation, labour, hire charges of machinery curing forconcrete works, cost and conveyance of all material and all other such incidental charges necessary for successful completionof works as per the detailed technical specification and direction of Engineer in charge of this work

Patching of Deep Potholes 75mm thick by restoring the Granular Base course using material confirming to WBM Grade -II with B Screenings standards wherever necessary by manual means including trimming the pothole to the required shape and size, cleaning the pothole, applying Prime Coat (SS1) at 0.70 kg per m2 over the WBM surface and covering the surface with SDBC 25mm thick including lead, loading unloading, rolling and finishing etc., complete as per specification
 ---- All the items in the tender include all lead, lifts, loading unloading, transportation, labour, hire charges of machinery curing forconcrete works, cost and conveyance of all material and all other such incidental charges necessary for successful completionof works as per the detailed technical specification and direction of Engineer in charge of this work
